measurements_and_build_method.coordinate_system: Project campus XY: X east, Y north, Z up, meters; origin latitude 40.4274, longitude -86.9137. Approximate local equirectangular conversion: X=(longitude+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)); Y=(latitude-40.4274)*111040.
measurements_and_build_method.roof_and_story_plate_outline: Tessellated directly from full GIS polygon; interior courtyard ring retained.
measurements_and_build_method.orientation: No independent rotation; GIS geometry copied via project prescribed conversion. Public entrance/atrium west side inferred from 2011 Purdue plan and illustrated site access. Entry bay center Y=-633.754m, estimated from longest nearly north-south west wall runs.

Facade source photos are oblique; rear and courtyard elevations are inferred from footprint and repeated facade rhythm.
